newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait stock index closes at new high, over 2,400.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait stock index closes at new high, over 2,400.

text.p: Investors on the Kuwait Stock Exchange appeared to brush aside fears of a correction with the index setting a record high on Tuesday for the second day.
The index rose 29.1 points on Monday and reached 2,423.3 during Tuesday's session before closing at 2,419.4 points, for a rise of 36.6 on the day.
Warnings of a crash by parliamentarians and a correction by economists emerged earlier this month after the index reached 2,354.7 points on April 27.
Trading value on Tuesday rose to 81.7 million dinars ($270.5 million) from 72.4 million on Monday. The daily average for the week to last Wednesday was 39 million dinars.

In late April, trading value on the KSE soared to a record 125.8 million dinars during a single 2-1/2-hour session in which 445 million shares were traded. Trading volume for the past two days was around 300 million shares changing hands a day, more than double the average for last week.

Big gainers included Kuwait Real Estate Co which closed at record high of 435 fils, rising 25 fils on Tuesday and 20 fils on Monday. Al-Ahleia Investment Co rose a total of 35 fils over the past two days to close at 510 fils.
There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
International Murabha Co shares also rose by a total of 35 fils over the past two days, closing at 385 fils, and First Investment Fund gained a total of 40 fils to 1.580 dinars.
